title: Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: Henry Park and Irene Santos discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for before the product launch in April, but Henry Park's revised estimate is by end of June at the latest. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'before the product launch in April' early in meeting, then revised to 'by end of June at the latest'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'before the product launch in April' and 'by end of June at the latest'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
